Everything you need is in White s City
White’s City, New Mexico (located 4 miles or 6.4 km east of Carlsbad Caverns National Park), is the perfect basecamp for your family s adventure and exploration.
Why stay anywhere else when White s City has everything you need? Located within minutes of the famous Carlsbad Caverns National Park, you ll be able to spend more time exploring and less time driving. We look forward to enhancing your adventure!

Perfect Basecamp for Exploring Carlsbad Caverns
Cozy rooms and all the amenities you could ask for.
Single King Room
Spacious room with one King pillow top Bed. Free Wifi, AC, Microwave & Mini Fridge, 42” Flat Screen TV with Satellite Channels, Coffeemaker, Full bath & shower and hair dryer.
*Iron & ironing board available upon request.
Handicap Accessible room available on Ground floor.
Pet-Friendly Rooms
$15 fee, per pet, per night. 2 Pet per room limit. Pets must be attended at all times, or secured in their travel crate.

Hotel Amenities
Closest Hotel to Carlsbad Caverns National Park.
Other Hotels NOT in White’s City, located in Carlsbad, NM, are 25+ miles away from the park entrance.
Pirate Ship Splash Pad
A unique oasis in the middle of the desert. Our Pirate Ship Splash Pad & Walnut Canyon Water Park are just another reason to book your next adventure with us!
Grab n Go Breakfast
Are you looking for a quick and nutritious breakfast before you head out for adventure? Get hot & fresh waffles, fresh fruit, cold cereal, pastries, coffee and juice.
Discount on Hot Breakfast
White s City Cavern Inn guests receive special breakfast and dinner discount at Cactus Cafe, next door.
